decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed convertion of the existing garage into a study room would not detract from the appearance of the subject dwellinghouse and would not be detrimental to the general amenity of the adjoining properties or the traffic related amenity of the surrounding area and is in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The means of access would need to be widened to 3.6m in order to access the two parking spaces proposed to the front of the dwelling.  The works hereby permitted shall not begin until details of the modified means of access to the highway have been submitted to and approved by the Council.
description: Conversion of existing garage to habitable room to dwellinghouse.
